nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Cảm xúc & ý kiến · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại 2 người bạn: lo lắng trước bài phát biểu
L: You've been quiet all day. What's on your mind?
I'm worried about my speech tomorrow. What if I forget everything?
Take a deep breath. You've practiced it a lot, haven't you?
Yes, I have. But my hands are shaking, and my heart is racing.
That's totally normal. Everyone gets nervous before a speech.
Really? You never look nervous when you speak.
Trust me, I was shaking last week! I just try to smile and speak slowly.
That actually helps. Can you listen to me practice tonight?
Of course! Don't worry, you'll do great. I'll be in the front row.

exq.q: What does Lily tell Khoa to do first?
How does Lily stay calm when she speaks?
exq.why: “I just try to smile and speak slowly.”
